summary: Backend-only retest of the 'latest KP for duplicate orders on same amocrm_id' fix. Verified seed data (sauna_orders ORD-OLD createdAt 2026-08-13 'OLD KP' + ORD-NEW createdAt 2026-08-16 'NEW KP', both amocrm_id=KPDUP_TEST_1; lead LEAD-KPDUP). All 8 pytest cases pass: widget orders-status now returns ORD-NEW/'NEW KP' (previous iteration_126 defect fixed), sauna-crm calculator-order regression holds (ORD-NEW), and other amocrm_id readers (widget delivery-status, widget embed/preview HTML, driver-panel debug/order, driver-panel warehouse-settings) return 200 with the freshest order and no stale 'OLD KP' anywhere. Static grep confirms sort=[('createdAt',-1)] added in widget.py (49,72), driver_panel.py (463,606,735,850), warehouse.py (257), telegram_production.py (95), sauna_crm.py (684,1693), amocrm.py (5 spots).

minor.issue: sauna_crm.py:631 find_one({'amocrm_id':...}) still has no sort=[('createdAt',-1)] — debug-only endpoint may report the stale order id, inconsistent with the fixed production paths
find_one on dovoz_orders by amocrm_id without sort (different collection; low risk, but same duplicate-doc pattern)

createdAt is stored as an ISO string; ordering works only while all docs use the same ISO/UTC format. Docs missing createdAt sort last on desc, so a legacy order without createdAt would never win — acceptable but worth noting

action_items: Optional: add sort=[('createdAt',-1)] to sauna_crm.py:631 (debug-kp) so debug output matches production selection
critical_code_review_comments: widget.py is 3228 lines — should be split into modules (helpers, HTML views, PDF/gifts handlers) per file-size guideline
Consider a compound index (amocrm_id, createdAt) on sauna_orders/orders/greenhouse_orders; every read now sorts by createdAt and unindexed sorts will degrade as data grows
get_all_orders_by_amocrm_id picks the 'first' section from a dict for backward compatibility — collection priority order is implicit; make it explicit if greenhouse+sauna dupes coexist
seed_data_creation: None created; reused existing seed KPDUP_TEST_1 / LEAD-KPDUP (ORD-OLD, ORD-NEW). Left intact for future regression runs.
test_credentials: admin/admin123 used only for driver-panel authenticated endpoints
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_latest_kp_duplicate_orders_iteration127.py (run with `python -m pytest tests/test_latest_kp_duplicate_orders_iteration127.py -o addopts=''`). Seed docs KPDUP_TEST_1 (ORD-OLD/ORD-NEW) and lead LEAD-KPDUP must stay in DB for it to pass. Note /api/widget/order/{id} does not exist (404 expected); driver-panel routes require Bearer token.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: find_one({'amocrm_id':...}) without sort returns natural/insertion order, so with duplicate orders per amocrm_id the oldest KP won. Fix adds sort=[('createdAt',-1)] at all read sites; verified end-to-end via public widget and sauna-crm endpoints returning ORD-NEW.
